subject.title: Track OpenClaw seams needed for full imported-plugin parity

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor these capabilities as source-neutral public host contracts, with each seam split into an independently approved upstream design item before Babelfish integration begins?
rationale: The request changes public SDK and manifest boundaries across runtime, authorization, authentication, bundle configuration, and installation ownership; implementation evidence cannot choose the permanent contracts or their sequencing.

options.title: Split and sponsor seams
options.body: Keep this issue as an umbrella and create independently reviewed upstream contracts for agent profiles, approvals, bundle projections, connectors, notifications, and installer delegation.

options.title: Approve a narrow tranche
options.body: Select only the lowest-risk seams for public API work now and leave the remaining imported contributions explicitly unsupported.

options.title: Defer full parity
options.body: Retain the support-matrix gaps without adding host APIs until OpenClaw independently needs each contract.

recommendation.title: Split and sponsor seams
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as an umbrella and create independently reviewed upstream contracts for agent profiles, approvals, bundle projections, connectors, notifications, and installer delegation.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the source-neutral seam analysis and have MEMBER association, making them the best available coordinator with upstream API and security owners.
